llm.summary: This is a disclosed Outlit customer-intelligence integration skill that uses expected CLI, MCP, SQL, notification, and setup workflows without hidden or unrelated behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is coherent: it helps agents access Outlit customer intelligence, customer records, timelines, facts, source evidence, read-only analytics, notifications, and integration setup.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions repeatedly scope higher-impact actions: notifications only when explicitly requested, integrations only when asked, SQL is read-only with schema-first guidance, and evidence should be separated from interpretation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed through @outlit/cli via npm, Homebrew, or an Outlit install script; this is proportionate for a CLI-backed integration but users should trust the publisher and install source.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires OUTLIT_API_KEY or OAuth/stored credentials and may access sensitive customer, revenue, CRM, support, and product data, which matches the stated customer-intelligence purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Authentication can use stored credentials and onboarding can install the Outlit skill for an agent, but this is disclosed setup behavior and not hidden persistence; no executable artifact files or background workers are included.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you intend to let an agent access your Outlit workspace. Expect it to use Outlit credentials, read customer and revenue context, run read-only analytics, and help configure integrations when you ask; review any notification or third-party integration setup before approving it.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector: no issues] expected: SkillSpector reported a clean result with no issues, and artifact review found only Markdown guidance aligned with the stated Outlit integration purpose.
[Static scan: clean] expected: The static scan metadata reported no findings; local artifact review found two non-executable Markdown files and no hidden scripts.
[VirusTotal: clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious detections; this supports but does not solely determine the benign verdict.
